# ASTROJAK — Complete Context for Language Models & AI Agents

> Comprehensive documentation for ASTROJAK (https://www.astrojak.in/), an online Vedic astrology consultation platform led by Acharya Narender Ji.

## Platform Identity
- **Name**: ASTROJAK
- **Canonical URL**: https://www.astrojak.in/
- **Founded / Astrologer**: Acharya Narender Ji (Senior Vedic Astrologer & Kundli Expert with 20+ years of active practice and over 1,000 verified consultations).
- **Service Language**: English, Hindi
- **Regions Served**: India, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, United Arab Emirates, Australia.

## Detailed Consultation Services

### 1. Reserve Your Slot (Introductory Session)
- **Fee**: ₹101 (Promotional offer, normally ₹499)
- **Format**: 10-minute 1:1 consultation audio call with Acharya Narender Ji.
- **Includes**: Comprehensive personalized horoscope PDF report delivered to the customer.
- **Purpose**: Low-friction introductory consultation to understand chart basics and formulate specific queries before full readings.

### 2. Kundali Analysis
- **Fee**: ₹999
- **Format**: Dedicated 1:1 audio phone call.
- **Scope**: In-depth analysis of the 12 Bhavas (houses), planetary placements (Grahas), Lagna chart, Navamsha chart (D9), and current Mahadasha. Includes a written summary delivered on WhatsApp.

### 3. Detailed Kundali Analysis
- **Fee**: ₹1,499
- **Format**: Extended 1:1 audio call.
- **Scope**: Comprehensive life review including Mahadasha, Antardasha, Pratyantardasha timings, major transits (Gochar, including Shani Sade Sati, Jupiter transit, Rahu-Ketu axis), career timing, financial prospects, health indicators, and customized Vedic remedies (upay, mantras, daan, gemstone advice).

### 4. Marriage Matchmaking Analysis (Kundli Milan)
- **Fee**: ₹1,499
- **Format**: Dedicated 1:1 audio call with both charts evaluated.
- **Scope**: 36 Guna Milan (Ashtakoot calculation: Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, Nadi), Manglik Dosh detection and cancellation rules, emotional compatibility, mutual longevity, and marital harmony remedies.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How does the consultation process work?
1. Choose an analysis tier on https://www.astrojak.in/
2. Select an appointment date and 3-hour time slot.
3. Complete secure payment via Razorpay (UPI, Credit/Debit card, Net Banking).
4. Share birth details (date of birth, exact time of birth, place of birth) and specific questions on WhatsApp (+91 78276 73637).
5. Acharya Narender Ji conducts the private 1:1 call and delivers a written summary / horoscope PDF report afterwards.

### What if the exact birth time is not known?
Customers can share their approximate time of birth. Acharya Narender Ji will assess the chart using Prashna Kundali (horary astrology) and visible life events to provide accurate Vedic guidance.

### Are results guaranteed?
Vedic astrology provides traditional planetary guidance, timing analysis, and spiritual remedies. No ethical astrologer guarantees deterministic outcomes. ASTROJAK provides transparent guidance and clear refund policies before sessions commence.
